term: potency, capacity and power across adopted and rival configurations
resolution: In every ADOPTED-POTENCY specialization, potency is precisely DEF-POTENCY: CanBe x r ∧ ¬ InAct x r, with one shared act predicate and respect throughout. All motion, priority, pure-act/immutability, eternity and attribute-sufficiency occurrences are uniformly substituted in the new frozen signatures; no proof transfers from this function to a separately supplied potency predicate. Generic original Challenges retain DEF-INDEPENDENT-POTENCY, including the act/potency-independence and Night models. Their simultaneous-act cases are a different interpretation, not refuted by adopting the definition. Night priority claims without simultaneous act can remain genuine rivals to act priority even under an adopted interpretation; no blanket defeat is claimed. A power/capacity retained during exercise is DEF-CAPACITY-TO-BE (or a causal capacity in DEF-POWER-CAPACITY-READING), not adopted unactualized capacity; its persistence while acting is consistent with the adopted definition. DEF-MEGARIAN-ACTUALIST-CAPACITY restricts the capacity relation itself. The existing one-way thesis is retained in full; it is not refuted by definition and its motion refutation keeps its additional premises. DEF-RECEPTIVE-POTENCY relates principles to a received act and can coexist with actual possession, so the adopted same-respect non-overlap theorem is never applied to it. DISAMB-IN-ACT independently distinguishes formal from virtual act; the adopted function uses exactly the supplied sense everywhere and does not attribute a virtual-act analysis to IX.6.
